messages:
Maya (Partner Ops): Heads-up — we need a concrete SEV path for Nebula marketplace launch. Proposed: 1) shared channel #nebula-partner-sev 2) partner liaison rotation (pingable) 3) warroom template with clear roles (liaison, SRE, Partner-Eng, PM) 4) PagerDuty -> Slack + auto-bridge. Thoughts? :eyes:

Jon (Support Eng): +1 to the shared channel & liaison idea. Quick Q — who does initial triage? Partner Eng first, then SRE if infra?

Priya (Marketplace PM): Agree. We should require a partner-signed runbook before GA and a visible outage badge on the listing. Also let's keep maintenance vs SEV separation.

Leo (SRE): For triage flow I suggest: app-level issues -> Partner Eng + Support; infra/GPU/network -> SRE. Severity mapping idea: SEV1 = outage -> immediate bridge; SEV2 = degraded -> dedicated shared channel; SEV3 = ticketed.

Maya (Partner Ops): Exactly what I was thinking. I'll own the liaison schedule if we agree on the flow. Need to decide SLAs for ACK/first-response.

Jon (Support Eng): Draft runbook snippet below — can we standardize it across partners?

```
Channel: #nebula-partner-sev
PagerDuty: pdb.team/redwood-nebula
Warroom flow:
- Partner reports incident
- Liaison ACK within 5m
- Triage owner (Partner Eng) in 15m
- If platform/infrastructure suspected -> SRE join within 30m
- Postmortem owner assigned within 48h
- Public status update cadence: 15m until stable
```

Priya (Marketplace PM): Will we need a separate channel for planned maintenance/events (pre-GA)? We don't want planned noise in the SEV channel.

Maya (Partner Ops): Good point — propose #nebula-maint for planned events. Liaison rotation: weekly, handoff note pinned with next-oncall and contact info.

RedwoodBot: Warroom created: https://meet.redwood/w/nebula-1725551234 (auto) :robot_face:

Leo (SRE): Also add fallback routing in runbook: if Nebula's dedicated infra is flapping, auto-fallback to hosted model variant after 2m of sustained errors. Document circuit-breaker thresholds.

Jon (Support Eng): I'll open a PR with the runbook and add a small template for onboarding new partners. Ping @Priya @Leo for review when ready.

Maya (Partner Ops): Thanks — if there are no objections I'll formalize and send to Nebula this afternoon. :thumbsup:

Priya (Marketplace PM): :thumbsup:
